why: I compared each check's PASS and FAIL conditions with the words of its expect line. Checks 1, 2 and 4 hold. Check 1's expected values follow from padding on the left, the default space and the exact width. Check 2 only asks that s comes back unchanged. Check 4 asks that all tests pass, and the exit-status-0 point sits under Advisory. Check 3 breaks the criterion. Its PASS condition requires "a heading that names that function, with text describing it." Expect line 3 only asks that README.md "has a section for every function index.js exports." It does not say the section must contain descriptive text. That added content requirement is a test the words do not force, and it sits in the PASS condition when it belongs under Advisory.
